new_accomplishments.text: I created starter template projects for C#/.NET and Node.js/React, providing reusable foundations for application development.
I provided technology reviews to support approval of technology adoption and implementation.
I implemented integrations between internal systems and Zendesk, along with various API integrations and services to connect applications and support product functionality.
I was the primary developer of a QA automation framework, carrying out nearly all of its development.
